VERDICT: FAIL

BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT - attested by third party) shows 72 tests pass, but the third-party reviewer note explicitly identifies that structured audit logging is missing. The self-report claims all three features are implemented, but this conflicts with the attested evidence from the independent reviewer. Since acceptance criterion (C) requires structured audit logging and the most reliable external evidence (ATT) contradicts the self-report, the work does not satisfy all acceptance criteria.
